text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. Air France 9066 intercept distress call from Lufthansa 1-4. Lufthansa 1-4 has a fuel emergency with 1-5 minutes endurance. Request landing priority. The aircraft's position is 1-5 miles east at 9,000 feet. Air France 9066, Roger Mayday. Break, break. Which of the following statements is true? Air France 9066, Roger Mayday.
